title: Finite-Sample Sensitivity of Kernel Metrics for Generative Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel distances such as the Kernel Inception Distance (KID) and the Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) compare generated and reference samples in an embedding space, and model comparisons rest on their values. Each ships with one fixed kernel, and a reported value does not say which changes that kernel detects at the sample size used. We run each default as a permutation two-sample test on real embeddings of symbolic music, audio and images, comparing a sample with an independent sample changed by a mean shift, an isotropic contraction, or a rotation that keeps the mean and the covariance trace and is matched to the shift in transport distance. At 780 samples per side, both defaults rarely detect the rotations in five evaluation spaces, while they detect the shifts in every run. The median-bandwidth Gaussian kernel of KAD detects the contraction and regains power against rotations on image embeddings with an order of magnitude more samples. Th

translated_title: 生成式评估中核度量在有限样本下的敏感性
translated_abstract: 核距离（如核Inception距离KID和核音频距离KAD）在嵌入空间中比较生成样本与参考样本，模型之间的比较依赖于这些数值。每种度量都只附带一个固定的核，而报告的数值并不能说明在所使用的样本量下该核能检测到哪些变化。我们在符号音乐、音频和图像的真实嵌入上，将每种默认核作为置换两样本检验来运行，将一个样本与经过均值偏移、各向同性收缩或旋转改变的独立样本进行比较，其中旋转保持均值和协方差迹不变，并与输运距离中的偏移相匹配。结果表明，在每侧780个样本时，两种默认核在五个评估空间中几乎无法检测到旋转，但在每次运行中都能检测到偏移。KAD所用的中值带宽高斯核能够检测到收缩，并且在图像嵌入上以多出一个数量级的样本量重新获得了对旋转的检测能力。
tldr: 该论文通过置换检验系统评估了KID和KAD等核度量在有限样本下对均值偏移、各向同性收缩和旋转的检测能力，发现默认核在每侧780个样本时无法检测旋转，而中值带宽高斯核可通过增加样本量恢复检测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates the finite-sample sensitivity of default kernel metrics (KID, KAD) to mean shifts, isotropic contractions, and rotations using permutation tests, showing that defaults at 780 samples per side fail to detect rotations, while the median-bandwidth Gaussian kernel regains rotation-detection power with an order of magnitude more samples.
